search_input.instructions: Complete the user's search task exactly and preserve native web source citations.
prompt_template: Perform one public-web search and answer in English.
For each result, provide its title, publication date, one-sentence description, and native source citation.
Search method: Bing Custom Search, with the search tool bound to a preconfigured website scope.
Search directly within the Custom Search configuration. Do not rely on a site: expression in this prompt to enforce website filtering.
Do not use information outside the configured scope to fill the result count. State clearly if no result is found.
